title: SettlementTest
description: The body WE send to your TEST address when a trial call is made (see webhooks.settlementTest). It carries no player, no points and no money, and it is never sent to your settlement endpoint.
x-serverSideChecks: schemaVersion is always "settlement-test.v1"; deliveryNonce is a new UUID on every call
answer 2xx to a correctly signed call; a call with a wrong signature must be refused (401)
